title: ever HAYLEN|Sequin Mermaid Round Neck Dress
descriptionHtml:
Step into elegance with this stunning formal dress, designed for the confident woman. It features shimmering sequins that sparkle under the lights, creating a captivating look. The flattering mermaid silhouette enhances your curves, while the soft fabric ensures comfort and ease of movement. Perfect for weddings, galas, or special occasions, this dress combines style with sophistication.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Tea Length


Sleeve Style: Short Sleeve


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back


Undergarments:Not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises sequin


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch
